subject.title: [Feature]: cron add: support custom job IDs via --id

question: Should OpenClaw add a public create-time custom cron job ID contract, and what validation/collision behavior should that contract use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding `--id` changes the public cron CLI/Gateway create surface and may also affect agent-created cron jobs, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Approve a narrow custom-id contract
options.body: Add optional safe custom IDs on create, reject duplicates explicitly, keep UUID generation as the default, and cover CLI/Gateway/service/docs/tests together.

options.title: Defer until a candidate PR is refreshed
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked implementation is ported, deconflicted, and proven on current main before deciding the contract.

options.title: Keep UUID-only creation
options.body: Decline the feature and close the related custom-id PRs if maintainers decide readable IDs should remain internal or unsupported.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow custom-id contract
recommendation.body: Add optional safe custom IDs on create, reject duplicates explicitly, keep UUID generation as the default, and cover CLI/Gateway/service/docs/tests together.
